data.narrative:
Swan is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Dima Kislovskiy and Narek Melik Barkhudarov that has raised $38.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning both public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private rounds (8 names including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI), all operating in the same sector and stage band.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology uses the $38.5M in total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis draws on three direct comparables in Defense & Security at Seed or Series A stage—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yielding a median comparable valuation of $400M. The peer set range spans $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $82M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $248M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage positioning relative to the peer set: Swan's current fundraising base suggests earlier-stage characteristics, while comparable valuations reflect later capital rounds in the same sector. Resolution of this gap depends on revenue traction, customer concentration, and near-term funding stage progression.
